# Review #449

Reviewed checkout `da552c64833f2e39ceeb1aeffb52a5b6299a7c1c`, fix `298727a0bf9ec03ab5a4788e8fd7249604f010cc` against its parent; the scoped diff adds only the completion counter and caller guard. `python3 -I` confirmed script SHA256 `55c236ada2bce447990c7185ac8654a2c8aefba32ae4010fac65ae82a15c8ecd` and synthetic fixture SHA256 `70d94d28084b45938c698e6097c8afd40934f8e9ab0d70a29de36d242ab4de34`.
`python3 -I -B benchmark/scripts/split_allocate.py --check` exited 0 without LABVIEW_ENVIRONMENT. The counter returns only after one reason self-test and seven mutation rejections: expected total 8. Repository files were unchanged.

## Standards
No documented standards violations found in the scoped change.

## Spec
1. **Blocking:** [reason self-test](../benchmark/scripts/split_allocate.py:222) fails to detect first-character-only comparison at line 192: `actual reason` and `expected reason` already differ in their first character. The weakened helper therefore passes all eight controls and exits 0. Use unequal self-test reasons sharing their first character and update the asserted error. [Evidence and method](artifacts/review449-probes.md).

| Independent temporary-copy probe | Exit | Message |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Return before reason self-test | 1 | split allocation check failed: rejecting controls did not complete: expected 8, got None |
| Return after first mutation | 1 | split allocation check failed: rejecting controls did not complete: expected 8, got None |
| Remove one mutation | 1 | split allocation check failed: rejecting controls did not complete: expected 8, got 7 |
| Compare only first reason character | 0 | No stderr; status pass, mutation_count 7 |

The script uses sequential mutation calls; the second probe returns after the first call, matching the requested interruption point.
2. **Non-blocking accepted limit (#421 finding 4):** coordinated removal of both controls and the caller count check remains undetected.

## What next
Policymaker: return this fix for the self-test correction before pinning the allocator hash. Saved [probe evidence](artifacts/review449-probes.md) describes exact mutations and results; temporary copies were removed. Rerun the four probes on the corrected candidate; do not repeat the broader specification review, F3 enumeration, or determinism investigation. This review does not establish benchmark readiness or goal completion.
